title: Stylish Downtown Apt w/ Pool, Walk to Broadway
description:
Welcome to your Nashville home base!
Just a 5-minute drive or ~20-minute walk to Broadway, music, nightlife, and top restaurants. This modern, stylish apartment is perfect for couples, friends, or a group trip.

Highlights:
• Open living space & fully equipped kitchen
• Bedroom + sofa bed
• Pool, grill & fitness center with beautiful view
• Fast Wi-Fi, smart TV & easy check-in
Street parking or use the parking garage for a small fee

The space
Inside, the apartment offers:

A cozy bedroom with a queen-sized bed for restful nights.
A queen-sized pull-out mattress in the living room, perfect for additional guests.
A fully stocked kitchen, complete with a Keurig coffee maker, espresso options, and all the essentials to whip up your favorite meals.
A sleek, fully equipped bathroom with all the necessities for a comfortable stay.
Cool neon signs throughout the space, creating a trendy Nashville-inspired vibe.
Step outside to enjoy incredible community amenities:

An outdoor heated pool with a hangout area perfect for relaxing, complete with a grill for cooking up your favorite meals.
A state-of-the-art fitness center with modern equipment to keep up with your workout routine. There is a ring camera on the door facing the hallway for security purposes. If you need parking there is a covered parking garage you can use for a small fee.
